title: casearia javitensis var. myriantha

It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, pain, and fever. The bioactive constituents of Myriantha include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
